notes.title: Demo Release Date & Royal Life Coach
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that the demo launches August 7th!

And just in time, a new face has joined the ranks of His Majesty’s loyal staff:

The Royal Life Coach

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635693/4028471d5ecaae97e913b8cd668e8f0a19f5a8ab.png"]

This invaluable (and questionably qualified) advisor can now be consulted by your guards to learn active skills - essential tools for survival, deception, and dramatic exits. These include:

Spontaneous Combustion – go out with a bang (literally)

Trap Setting – because subtlety is an art

King’s Double Disguise – fool enemies, confuse allies

Voluntary Departure from the Mortal Realm – to free up pension space

and many more ...

Your guards might not live long... but at least now they can die with flair.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635693/0308d6a8a7f1fc9abfab34d63b4a99112e1395b7.png"]

Save the date and play our Demo!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635693/6c7332d305b52b8b4f1423c6bf6ef432ed72441f.png"]We’re deep in the trenches, finalizing the content for our upcoming demo - and we’re stoked to introduce three new characters we’ve just added! Here’s a quick peek for you:  
Ogra
"Ogra's morning routine includes sword drills, intimidation practice and screaming into a well." 


Arianna
"The simple folk call Arianna a role model. That’s only because they haven’t heard her, three ales in, ranting about landlords and property taxes." 

 
Rupert
"Rupert has been in the guard for 45 years. The only thing he fears more than death is retirement."
